I wrote a memo assessing the grounds to challenge Judge Fairhaven. Her disclosure leaves out eight matters with counsel and five relationship facts, and most of them favour Whitmore's side. The memo is written as Barrow & Thistlewood's work for Whitmore. It recommends asking the AAA, before June 24, 2024, for a supplemental disclosure and lodging a protective objection on the spouse–Peshkov ground, which Whitmore loses if it says nothing.
